prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: editorial cover illustration for LineCheck reading-assistance website, landscape 3:2 aspect ratio. Style: refined contemporary editorial illustration, softly textured matte paper, restrained hand-drawn shapes, natural adult proportions, quiet human emotion, elegant simple composition, not a UI screenshot, not a marketing infographic. Palette: warm ivory background (#f7f8f2), muted sage green, deep forest-green linework (#20392f), warm beige skin tones; tiny terracotta accent only where helpful. Soft daylight, uncluttered desk, generous breathing room, main subjects inside central 80 percent so the edges may crop a little. No written text, no letters, no numbers, no slogans, no logos, no watermark. Represent webpage text by clean abstract short horizontal strokes, not gibberish. Flat illustration with subtle paper grain, no glossy 3D, no photos. Scene: A reader returning to a long web article after a phone interruption. Three-quarter over-the-shoulder view of an adult seated at a laptop, one relaxed hand near the trackpad and the other setting a phone face down. Their slight head tilt expresses the familiar 'where was I?' moment, without exaggerated frustration. The laptop screen contains a long column of faint text-like strokes with one single horizontal line clearly highlighted in pale green as a place to return to. A small curve in the arrangement guides the eye back to that line. The phone sits quietly to one side; the article is the main visual focus. Create a warm, relatable scene about finding your place again.
